# Alessandro N. Garritano

> Microbial ecologist and bioinformatician. Postdoctoral Research Associate at The University of Sydney and Adjunct Fellow at UNSW Sydney. Studies how microbes move carbon, nitrogen and phosphorus through soils and through marine hosts such as deep sea sponges and corals.

ORCID 0000-0002-8159-5178, Wikidata Q139979362. Papers are listed below with their DOIs; the DOI link is the authoritative version.

- [Who am I](https://www.alessandrogarritano.com/): background, current work and research themes
- [Research](https://www.alessandrogarritano.com/research.html): research questions from the Master's to the current postdoc, with the papers behind each
- [Publications](https://www.alessandrogarritano.com/publications.html): all papers and preprints
